fields.statement: The plan's rewrite of usage-governor-hold-rules (01M6HHVZ) changes its hold sentence to match usage-live-run-remaining and usage-hold: the daemon holds a new pick when the window's use so far, plus for each live run the mean tokens of the last 10 finished runs less that run's tokens so far (never below zero), plus one full mean for the run it would start, exceeds the limit minus the reserve. With no finished runs to average, only the use so far counts. The rest of the rewritten statement stays as planned.
